# Edges models

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from the model cards; do not edit. -->

4 edges models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: one RGB image. Output: a line / edge map `[H, W]` in [0, 1] at the input size (1 = line), the ControlNet preprocessors (line art, HED, PiDiNet, TEED / Anyline); M-LSD also returns straight line segments.

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB; `fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW` measures yours. The summary uses one input, 1080x1920: kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under `torch.compile` and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable ([export](../export.md); memory: the engine's device memory + torch's peak). – = not measured.

Other devices: [Apple M1 Pro 16 GB](../devices/apple-m1-pro-16gb.md), [NVIDIA L4](../devices/l4-22gb.md), [NVIDIA L40S](../devices/l40s-44gb.md), [NVIDIA A10](../devices/a10-22gb.md), [NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB](../devices/a100-sxm4-40gb.md), [NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000](../devices/rtx-pro-6000-96gb.md); [across devices](../benchmarks.md#other-devices).

| model | commercial |
|---|---|
| [`hed`](#hed) | yes |
| [`lineart`](#lineart) | yes |
| [`lineart-anime`](#lineart_anime) | yes |
| [`lineart-coarse`](#lineart) | yes |

<a id="hed"></a>

## HED soft edges (ControlNet 1.1)

HED edges (Xie and Tu, ICCV 2015; ControlNet's Apache-2.0 re-implementation): soft, thick edge maps of a photo at several scales, the input of the soft-edge ControlNet. Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Speed and memory not measured for: `hed`.

<details><summary>Details</summary>

- Paper: [Holistically-Nested Edge Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/1504.06375), ICCV 2015, 2015-04-24
- Paper: [Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.05543), ICCV 2023, 2023-02-10
- Original code: <https://github.com/huggingface/controlnet_aux> at `b1aac318b15c`
- Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: `LICENSE`
- Weights licence: Apache-2.0
- Licence evidence: https://github.com/huggingface/controlnet_aux/blob/b1aac318b15c4e65a21bc516dc236ad4bf593d46/src/controlnet_aux/hed/__init__.py ; https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/Annotators
- Training data: Not stated for these checkpoints (lllyasviel/Annotators, ControlNet 1.1); HED (Xie and Tu) trains on BSDS500; this re-trained model states no data.
- Options: `resolution` = 512 (>= 64; also `detect_resolution`), `safe` = False
- Kernel libraries: none (a VGG-style CNN: cuDNN convolutions are the whole time; no custom kernel measured to pay off)
- Variants: `hed`
- Outputs: edges
- Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
- Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): `hed` not measured yet

### Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.002 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.02 and p99 <= 0.25 (absolute error of the output `edges`).

| variant | kernels error vs original, mean / p99 | GPU, torch | kernels used |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hed` | no kernels backend | - | - |

</details>

<a id="lineart"></a>

## Line art (informative-drawings)

Informative-drawings line art (MIT CSAIL, CVPR 2022), as packaged for ControlNet: draws the lines of a photo as a sketch-like map, the input of the line-art ControlNet; a fine and a coarse version. MIT code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Speed and memory not measured for: `lineart`, `lineart-coarse`.

<details><summary>Details</summary>

- Paper: [Learning to generate line drawings that convey geometry and semantics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.12691), CVPR 2022, 2022-03-23
- Paper: [Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.05543), ICCV 2023, 2023-02-10
- Original code: <https://github.com/huggingface/controlnet_aux> at `b1aac318b15c`
- Code licence: MIT (permissive); files: `LICENSE`
- Weights licence: MIT (assumed from code)
- Licence evidence: https://github.com/huggingface/controlnet_aux/blob/b1aac318b15c4e65a21bc516dc236ad4bf593d46/src/controlnet_aux/lineart/LICENSE ; https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/Annotators
- Training data: Not stated for these checkpoints (lllyasviel/Annotators, ControlNet 1.1); informative-drawings trains on unpaired photographs and line drawings.
- Options: `resolution` = 512 (>= 64; also `detect_resolution`)
- Kernel libraries: none (a small conv generator: cuDNN convolutions and instance norm are the whole time; no custom kernel measured to pay off)
- Variants: `lineart`, `lineart-coarse`
- Outputs: edges
- Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
- Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): `lineart` not measured yet; `lineart-coarse` not measured yet

### Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.002 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.02 and p99 <= 0.25 (absolute error of the output `edges`).

| variant | kernels error vs original, mean / p99 | GPU, torch | kernels used |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lineart` | no kernels backend | - | - |
| `lineart-coarse` | no kernels backend | - | - |

</details>

## Anime line art

Anime line art (a pix2pix U-Net, as packaged for ControlNet by lllyasviel): draws the clean outlines of an anime or cartoon image as a line map, the input of the anime line-art ControlNet. MIT code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Speed and memory not measured for: `lineart-anime`.

<details><summary>Details</summary>

- Paper: [Image-to-Image Translation with Conditional Adversarial Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/1611.07004), CVPR 2017, 2016-11-21
- Paper: [Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.05543), ICCV 2023, 2023-02-10
- Original code: <https://github.com/huggingface/controlnet_aux> at `b1aac318b15c`
- Code licence: MIT (permissive); files: `LICENSE`
- Weights licence: MIT (assumed from code)
- Licence evidence: https://github.com/huggingface/controlnet_aux/blob/b1aac318b15c4e65a21bc516dc236ad4bf593d46/src/controlnet_aux/lineart_anime/LICENSE ; https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/Annotators
- Training data: Not stated for these checkpoints (lllyasviel/Annotators, ControlNet 1.1); ControlNet 1.1 describes the anime line art model as trained on anime illustrations and their line drawings.
- Options: `resolution` = 512 (>= 64; also `detect_resolution`)
- Kernel libraries: none (a pix2pix U-Net: cuDNN convolutions and instance norm are the whole time; no custom kernel measured to pay off)
- Variants: `lineart-anime`
- Outputs: edges
- Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
- Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): `lineart-anime` not measured yet

### Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.002 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.02 and p99 <= 0.25 (absolute error of the output `edges`).

|---|---|---|---|
| `lineart-anime` | no kernels backend | - | - |

</details>
